text: Options are what makes one item different from another. <break time="0.8s"/> The label is what renter will see. <break time="0.5s"/> The name is the system key the item is saved under, and used for an item match. <break time="0.8s"/> The type can bool, string or a number. <break time="0.5s"/> The required option means this item is needed to complete the order and should always be true. <break time="0.5s"/> The values are the list of selections the dropdown will offer.
